name: em
description: Engineering-manager skills for executing tracked work, with no fixed lifecycle. `start` scopes one ticket (fetch, ground in decisions, read the touched code, ask only the questions nothing else can answer) and stops at a brief. `lead` takes any work reference, checks from the ticket body whether it is already shaped, picks an execution shape (inline, one worker, parallel workspaces, test-first), dispatches, and verifies every result by diff before a pre-push stop. Tracker-agnostic: Linear, Fibery, and GitHub Issues through per-tracker adapters, selected by the reference form or a repo-local `.em.toml`. Pairs with the pm plugin, which shapes the tickets em executes.
